name: Landgasthof zur Post
beschreibung: Landgasthof zur Post is situated in the picturesque village of Landl within the Thiersee community in the Kufstein district. Surrounded by rolling meadows and pine forests at the base of the Tyrolean Alps, this family-managed inn provides a tranquil mountain retreat. Well-kept alpine-style guest rooms ensure restful relaxation. The welcoming restaurant parlor serves wholesome Tyrolean comfort food, hearty roasts, and homemade desserts prepared with local farm ingredients. Hikers, nature enthusiasts, and families appreciate its proximity to Thiersee lake, scenic valley walking routes, and nearby winter sports centers.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming country inn in Landl in the Thiersee municipality featuring home-style Tyrolean cooking.
